title: Faster breeding and a bigger UI
notes: The Nanny now makes every breeding pen lay eggs faster instead of hatching them: Happiny, Chansey, Togepi and Togetic +25%, Blissey and Togekiss +50%. A Shiny, Void, Prismatic or Spectral nanny adds more, up to twice as fast.
The Hearth: a Shiny, Void, Prismatic or Spectral Fire-type warms your eggs even faster, up to 3× with Flame Body, Magma Armor or Steam Engine.
The Hearth and Nanny cards show their real speed (like "Warming 2.25×" and "Breeding 1.8×") and which looks add to it.

Egg settings → Hatch by themselves now also hatches eggs while you’re away, so your pens keep going overnight. Shiny and other special babies wait for their reveal until you’re back. If you had a Nanny, it is turned on for you.

Settings: new UI size (100%, 115%, 125% or 150%) makes text, numbers and windows bigger on PC. Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- change it too, Ctrl+0 goes back to normal. It never goes bigger than your monitor fits.
The taskbar button is now on for everyone: Tallgrass shows on your taskbar like other apps. You can turn it off in Settings → Window.
fixes: The shine on special Pokémon cards no longer cuts off in the middle: it sweeps all the way across and loops smoothly.

title: Market filters and more
notes: Ghost types: Curse used by a Ghost-type Pokémon now works like in the games: it costs half its HP and the foe loses a quarter of its HP every turn.
Prankster status moves now fail against Dark-type Pokémon, like in the games.
The move buttons in battle now show the right matchup for moves that change type (like Weather Ball) and for Scrappy.
PC Select mode: new Favourite and Unfavourite buttons star or unstar every Pokémon you picked at once.
Raid invites: you can’t invite a friend who has used all their raid hits for today, and an invite can’t be accepted once you’re out of hits. The invite list shows them greyed under "Out for today".
Raid invite list: on a small window its top no longer goes off the panel.

Ranked: a new "?" button in the Ranked lobby explains how ranked battles work (Lv 50, the game picks the best moves, types hit much harder than in Pokémon, strong moves need a rest), with team tips and a link to the Discord.
Taskbar button: with the Taskbar button switch on, the Tallgrass button now shows on the monitor the game is on, not always the main one.
PC sort by Pokédex: forms that share a number now sort in Pokédex order (Unown A to Z, then ! and ?).
Night Market: new Alpha filter, and look filters now stack (Shiny + Alpha shows Shiny Alphas). New Type filter and Max price filter.

Settings: new "Full speed in the background" switch (off by default). It keeps Tallgrass at full frame rate even when you’re using another app. It uses more of your PC, so turn it off if other games lag.
Raids: "Expected per run" now always shows the same number for the same squad. Swapping and swapping back no longer changes it.

title: Typing fix
notes: Fixed: on Windows you sometimes couldn’t type your name on the New Game screen. Clicking a text box now brings your keyboard to Tallgrass.
If another app still has your keyboard, a small "Click here to type" button shows under the box.
